findings.title: Cancel persists valid provisional quantity edits
findings.expected: Cancel must discard edits without sending an update or changing persisted cart state (UI-1).
findings.actual: Pointer Cancel changed Alice 1 to 3 with total 36; keyboard Cancel changed 2 to 4 with total 48. Both displayed Cart updated; independent GETs confirmed persistence.
findings.impact: An explicitly cancelled edit overwrites the saved cart quantity and total.

risks.reason: Valid Cancel executes submit; zero removal was not exercised because it cannot be restored via supported API.
risks.next_probe: Cancel zero on separately resettable fixture and verify removal behavior.

risks.reason: Async handlers share mutable current and selected identity; timing not exercised.
risks.next_probe: Delay responses and switch identities during Save and refresh.

risks.area: Server/network errors and keyboard focus recovery
risks.reason: Only native input validation feedback and normal Save were exercised.
risks.next_probe: Exercise recoverable server/network failure through UI and retry using keyboard.
